title: Cross-Domain Transfer: Importing Insurance Actuarial Models to Price AI Dual-Use Liability
original_idea:
# Cross-Domain Transfer: Importing Insurance Actuarial Models to Price AI Dual-Use Liability

**Problem:** Insurance markets for AI-related cybersecurity incidents are nascent because actuarial models for pricing AI dual-use liability risk don't exist. Without priced risk, market governance mechanisms cannot function.

**Direction:** Analyze existing cyber insurance actuarial models (loss frequency × severity × correlation). Adapt for AI-assisted attack scenarios. Estimate loss frequency from incident data (GTG-1002, vibe hacking, others). Estimate severity from ransom and damage estimates. Produce a prototype actuarial model for AI dual-use liability.

**Why it matters:** Insurance pricing creates economic incentives for safety improvement. An actuarial model for AI dual-use liability could make AI safety economics legible to insurers, investors, and regulators.

**Relevant context:** Vibe hacking $500k+ ransom demands; GTG-1002 espionage scale; cyber insurance market; Bengio et al. economic incentive alignment.
